chunks: And by this chain, he said: Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
When you are brought the bread and the meat, so begin with the bread, so close by it the emptiness of the hunger, then eat the meat.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended order for eating bread and meat according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this instruction from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) to prioritize bread over meat, reflecting the Shia emphasis on *adab al-ta'am* (etiquette of eating) and the practical wisdom of consuming staple foods first to ensure satiety. This hadith underscores the Prophetic tradition of moderation and gratitude, where the humble bread serves as the primary means to quell hunger before enjoying the more luxurious meat.
